places.name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this ancient rock fortress features frescoes, water gardens, and breathtaking views from the summit.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for the climb and carry water.

attribution.title: Batticaloa Portuguese (dutch) fort

places.name: Lion’s Paw Staircase & Frescoes
places.ai_summary: An iconic feature of Sigiriya, this staircase with lion's paw carvings leads up to the fortress, accompanied by ancient frescoes.

opening_hours.notes: Frescoes are best viewed in the morning light.

places.place_tip: Take your time to appreciate the details of the frescoes.

places.name: Mirror Wall & Water Gardens
places.ai_summary: The Mirror Wall, once polished to reflect like a mirror, and the ancient water gardens are remarkable features on the way to the summit.

opening_hours.notes: Water gardens are best visited in the early morning.

places.place_tip: Look for the ancient graffiti on the Mirror Wall.

places.name: Pidurangala Rock Hike (Sunrise View)
places.ai_summary: A popular hiking spot offering panoramic views of Sigiriya Rock and the surrounding landscapes, especially stunning at sunrise.

opening_hours.notes: Bring a flashlight if hiking before sunrise.

places.place_tip: Climb early for the best views and cooler weather.

places.name: Sigiriya Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history, art, and archaeology of the Sigiriya region, enhancing the understanding of the ancient site.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the fortress for a full historical experience.

places.name: Village Safari & Bullock Cart Ride
places.ai_summary: An immersive experience into the rural life of Sri Lanka, featuring a bullock cart ride and a safari through local villages.

opening_hours.notes: Best experienced in the late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Interact with locals and learn about traditional farming methods.

places.ai_summary: A breathtaking hot air balloon ride offering aerial views of the Sigiriya region, including the rock fortress and surrounding landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Weather dependent; book in advance.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views.

places.name: Ibbankatuwa Megalithic Tombs
places.ai_summary: Ancient burial sites dating back to the Megalithic Age, offering insight into the island's prehistoric period.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guide for historical context.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby museum for a complete experience.

places.name: Sigiriya Lake Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walk around the lake at the base of Sigiriya Rock, offering beautiful views and a chance to see local wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Early morning or late afternoon is best for wildlife spotting.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching and a camera for photos.

places.name: Cultural Show in Habarana
places.ai_summary: A vibrant cultural performance showcasing traditional Sri Lankan dance, music, and fire walking, typically held in the evenings.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule in advance as shows may vary.

places.place_tip: Arrive early for good seats and to explore the area.

places.name: Elephant Back Safari (Eco-Friendly)
places.ai_summary: A unique safari experience riding on the back of an elephant through the jungles and fields of Sigiriya.

opening_hours.notes: Ensure the operator follows ethical elephant tourism practices.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothing and be ready for a bumpy ride.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching and a camera for wildlife photography.

places.place_tip: Don’t forget to explore all five caves.
